cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(coverage_fixture LANGUAGES C CXX)
include(CTest)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
option(FIXTURE_FAIL "Exercise coverage reporting after a failed test" OFF)
add_library(sample SHARED libcalc.c libunused.c)
target_compile_options(sample PRIVATE -O2)
add_executable(check_sample check.c)
target_link_libraries(check_sample PRIVATE sample)
if(FIXTURE_FAIL)
    add_test(NAME fixture COMMAND check_sample fail)
else()
    add_test(NAME fixture COMMAND check_sample)
endif()
include("${TEAL_TEST_HELPER}")
teal_enable_coverage("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/coverage.json")
